reviewed_original_scope.statement: For every real phase of a billiard family in a noncircular original ellipse with a strict nested nondegenerate confocal elliptical caustic and even least period N≥4, including every coprime star turning, form the outer vertices as consecutive original tangent intersections. At either original focus use the full perpendicular lines through those outer vertices and the arithmetic mean of their consecutive intersections. All real intersections are finite and unique. The mean is phase invariant, lies on the original focal axis, negates under focus exchange, and is the original center for N=4.
